title: Lamb Kebabs with Algerian Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic lamb kebab dish with Algerian spices, great for a quick dinner or outdoor BBQ.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, mix together Algerian spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
2. Add the spice mixture to the lamb cubes and mix well to coat.
3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
5. Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
6. Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
7. Return the lamb to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
8. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the lamb is cooked through.
9. Serve hot, garnished with additional Algerian spices if desired.
